pv40:1.1: [FOOTNOTES] Revatīpetavatthu catutthaṃ Idaṃ mama ucchuvanaṃ mahantaṃ nibbattati puññaphalaṃ anappakaṃ taṃ dāni me paribhogaṃ na upeti ācikkha bhante kissa ayaṃ vipāko. || ||
pv40:2.1: Haññāmi khajjāmi ca vāyamāmi parisakkāmi paribhuñjituṃ kiñci svāhaṃ chinnathāmo kapaṇo lālapāmi kissa kammassa ayaṃ vipāko. || ||
pv40:3.1: Vighāto cāhaṃ paripatāmi chamāyaṃ parivattāmi vāricaro va ghamme rudato ca me assukā niggalanti ācikkha bhante kissa ayaṃ vipāko. || ||
pv40:4.1: Chāto kilanto ca pipāsito ca santasito sātasukhaṃ na vinde pucchāmi taṃ etam atthaṃ bhadante kathan nu ucchuparibhogaṃ labheyyaṃ. || || Pure
pv40:5.1: tuvaṃ kammam akāsi attanā manussabhūto purimāya jātiyā ahañ ca taṃ etam atthaṃ vadāmi sutvāna tvaṃ etam atthaṃ vijāna. || ||
pv40:6.1: Ucchuṃ tvaṃ khādamāno payāto puriso ca te piṭṭhito anvagacchi so ca taṃ paccāsanto kathesi tassa tuvaṃ na kiñ ci ālapittha. || ||
pv40:7.1: So ca taṃ abhaṇantaṃ ayāci deh' ayya ucchun ti ca taṃ avoca tassa tuvaṃ piṭṭhito ucchuṃ adāsi tass' etaṃ kammassa ayaṃ vipāko. || ||
pv40:8.1: Iṅgha tuvaṃ piṭṭhito gaṇha ucchuṃ gahetvāna khādassu yāvad atthaṃ ten' eva tvaṃ attamano bhavissasi haṭṭho udaggo ca pamodito ca. || || Gantvāna
pv40:9.1: so piṭṭhito aggahesi gahetvāna taṃ khādi yāvad atthaṃ ten' eva so attamano ahosi haṭṭho udaggo ca pamodito cā ti. || ||
